1. What is HTML? HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language used to create and structure content on the web. It's not a programming language — it's a markup language that uses tags to describe the structure and meaning of content (headings, paragraphs, links, images, etc.) so browsers know how to display it. 2.
